title: Doesn't rotate
text: Doesn't rotate. I bought this to put in my cupboard for spices. I already had a Rubbermaid turntable but the spices would fall off sometimes, so I thought this would be better. The turntable that comes with this hardly turns, just drags. It was missing a ball bearing, which was not in the box, so it was packed that way, but even so, it wouldn't have made much difference in the rotation. Once I put the spices in, it didn't turn at all, just slid around on the shelf.  I am giving it two stars and keeping it  only because I was able to use the round container on top of my Rubbermaid turntable and make it work, otherwise I would be returning it.
